name: Translucent PETG
notes: Transparent-volume starting point. Transmission distance and IOR need runtime verification and per-color calibration. Typical procedural Normal/Roughness maps are Filamentra estimates, not measured or manufacturer maps. PBR transmission 0.55, haze 0.55, and attenuation 12 mm are uncalibrated reference estimates for a 2-mm FDM wall.
